name: 角鸊鷉

iucn.assessmentNote: 全球VU；香港偶見（單一記錄）

illustrationTaxon: Podiceps auritus adult in breeding plumage; main image and diagnostic features

similarSpecies.distinction: 小鸊鷉較小（25–29 cm）、體形矮圓、深冠淡眼，繁殖羽有橙褐頰頸和黃色嘴角斑；角鸊鷉稍大，頭頂具金黃色角狀耳羽、紅眼及胸栗色頸。
鳳頭鸊鷉體型大得多（46–61 cm）、長頸、長而纖細的淡色喙，冬羽白臉白前頸與深色冠；角鸊鷉約31–38 cm，繁殖羽有金黃色角狀耳羽及栗色頸胸。

featureNotes: 繁殖羽耳後有明顯金黃角狀羽簇，是名稱特徵
虹膜紅色，頭部及喉部深色，與栗色頸胸對比
頭頸胸為濃栗色，背及上體深色
喙直而尖，尖端帶淡色；頭頂輪廓較平

rangeMap.note: Partial overview of countries intersecting the broad Holarctic range: breeding mainly across northern regions of Eurasia and North America, with wintering on coasts of Europe and East Asia and along both North American coasts. The selected countries are only an overview, not nationwide occupancy or exact seasonal/subspecies polygons; Hong Kong's single accidental record is not marked as resident range.

sources.use: Full HKBWS account read: Category I accidental in Hong Kong, with a single record off the Mai Po boardwalk on 9 April 1996, in breeding plumage. Adult breeding identification: flat-crowned head, straight pale-tipped bill, red eye, golden-yellow ear tufts, rich rufous-brown underparts and dark upperparts. HKBWS describes winter separation from Black-necked Grebe by a crisp dark-cap/white-cheek boundary and paler fore-neck. IUCN Vulnerable, global population decreasing rapidly; global status and Hong Kong single record are kept distinct. Eurasian breeding/winter range and North American subspecies described separately.

Cornell eBird/Merlin account read: compact grebe; golden ear tufts behind red eye and rich chestnut neck/body in breeding plumage; winter birds have black cap and contrasting white cheek. Cross-check for taxon-specific adult art.

Full HKBWS Little Grebe account read for comparator: 25–29 cm, compact rounded body, dark crown and pale eyes, short blunt bill; adult breeding plumage has orange-brown cheeks/neck and yellow gape mark.

Full HKBWS Great Crested Grebe account read for comparator: 46–61 cm, much larger long-necked bird with long slender largely pale bill; winter plumage white face/fore-neck and dark crown/eye-bill stripe.
